Necessary cookies are essential cookies required to enable core functionality of this website, for example, site security, network management and accessibility. We also use non-essential cookies – functional cookies and advertising cookies - to understand how you use our site to evaluate and improve the site’s performance and provide a better site experience. We may also use this information to better understand your interests and deliver personalised advertising to you. You may choose for all Ascott’s brand websites to:
“Accept cookies” will mean accepting all essential and non-essential cookies;
“Decline cookies” will mean to reject all non-essential cookies; or
“Change settings” will allow you to select your preference.

    At Ascott, we believe the world is yours to explore. With a wide range of accommodation options – including serviced residences, hotels, resorts, social living spaces and branded residences – we empower you to Stay Your Way as you embrace Global Living with Unlimited Possibilities. Wherever your journey takes you, every stay with Ascott is a heartfelt experience waiting to unfold.
